hypothesis: CBM code anchors combined with bounded post-version Git history can retrieve useful merged PR evidence beyond the strengthened lexical controls.

method.interval: Reported version must be an ancestor of the fixed upper commit. Candidates are descendants of the version and ancestors of the upper commit, excluding the version itself.
method.upper_semantics: Last commit of the registered graph prefix, not a claim about the latest branch tip.
anchors: last repository frame in each traceback
controls: upper-snapshot intervals with the same qualified name
method.file_change: Native Git first-parent diff changes the exact path; rename following is not claimed.
method.ranking: Earliest position in native Git's reversed topological descendant interval, with PR number as a deterministic tie-breaker.
method.correspondence: Same qualified name is a candidate endpoint correspondence, not proven symbol lineage.
method.labels: Closing PR references are read only after independent code and lexical candidate generation.

independent_first_parent_diff_checks.scope: Every file-based evidence item in each code arm's first 100 candidates

cost.source_verifier_without_id_index: Stopped its own process after more than 156 seconds; query-plan inspection showed a repeated full scan of selected observations.
cost.source_verifier_with_id_index: Temporary unique ID index changes the lookup plan from SCAN to SEARCH and leaves the frozen selection digest unchanged.

additional_merged_references_beyond_ever.inspection: The log dereferences a missing tokenizer in process_inputs. The PR guards that call and adds a skip-tokenizer-initialization regression test. A different unmerged proposal was already found by lexical search.

The log shows invalid grammar reaching the engine and causing shutdown. The PR validates fallback grammar and adds invalid-regex, JSON-schema and grammar request tests. Its changes are outside the compile_grammar symbol interval.

findings: The two new merged candidates are recovered equally by raw traceback paths: this round establishes temporal file evidence, not an incremental graph-topology benefit.
Requiring a CBM symbol for every usable file loses valid path coordinates such as wrappers and properties; file and symbol evidence need separate meanings.
A merge can appear in path-limited Git history without changing the path relative to its first parent. Adversarial merge fixtures and native first-parent diffs prevent that false edge.
Large fixed upper snapshots can lose or rename relevant symbols. Even a surviving same-name function may not contain the neighboring validation or registration change that addresses the failure.
Combining ranked lists is not monotonically helpful. Existing lexical lanes remain available; no universal fused ordering is promoted.
limitations: Linked PRs are incomplete relevance references, not proof of causal fixes. No GPU or end-to-end agent reproduction was performed.
This is retrospective retrieval over frozen available evidence, not prediction using only facts available when each issue was created.
Ranking near the reported version is a heuristic, not a measured probability of relevance or shortest graph distance.
The upper graph projection omits and reports 98 dangling edges. This round uses symbol lookup, not graph-edge traversal.
No held-out retrieval, cross-repository validation, source writes, all-history graph copies, pushes or merges.

next.hypothesis: Diagnostic entity lookup at the reported version, followed by native CBM typed relationships, can recover relevant code evidence absent from the traceback path controls.
controls: diagnostic entity files without graph expansion
acceptance: Generate diagnostic entities from verbatim logs without repository-specific vocabulary, issue titles or reference PRs.
Keep entity resolution and graph traversal as separate ablations; preserve ambiguous and unresolved results.
Use CBM's actual query engine and retain relationship type, source coordinates, resolution strategy and confidence when available.
Do not confuse a mentioned entity, static dependency or same-name endpoint with proven runtime causality.
Retain lexical and path evidence lanes, record truncation and cost, and keep held-out retrieval unqueried until a meaningful checkpoint.
